items.stem: You must aggregate results from many parallel sub-tasks and continue when all finish. Which Durable Functions pattern fits?

options.text: Fan-out/fan-in with an orchestrator awaiting all activities

options.rationale: A stateless function cannot track parallel completion reliably.

options.text: A timer trigger every minute polling status
options.rationale: Polling is wasteful and fragile here.

options.text: Storing state in a global variable
options.rationale: Global state is not durable across instances.
